bio.text: Elaine Luria, a former Navy commander, won the 2026 Democratic primary for Virginia's 2nd Congressional District and is set to face Republican Rep. Jen Kiggans in November.
Luria represented the 2nd District in Congress from 2019 to 2023 and lost the seat to Kiggans in 2022.
According to WHRO, she served as a naval officer for 20 years.

sources.title: Former U.S. Rep. Elaine Luria announces run for her old congressional seat | WVTF
Luria to face Kiggans again after Democratic primary win | WVTF
